remarks: Now offering 1/2 off the second months rent, this charming 2-bedroom, 1-bathroom that lives like a 3-bedroom won't last much longer. This home is located in the vibrant city of Stamford, CT. This property boasts a range of desirable features that make it a perfect blend of comfort and style. Step inside to find beautiful hardwood floors that add a touch of elegance to the space. The home is equipped with central heat and a decorative fireplace, ensuring a cozy atmosphere during the colder months. The kitchen is a chef's dream with its stunning granite countertops. The property also includes a finished walk out basement, providing extra storage or potential for additional living space. Outside, you'll find a spacious yard, perfect for outdoor activities or gardening. Additionally, the home comes with a dedicated laundry area. This home is a perfect blend of functionality and style, waiting for you to make it your own. Just a short walk to Cove Island Beach!
